name: Panorama Block – Display 360-Degree Panoramic Views
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Panorama is a 360-degree panorama viewer Gutenberg Block that lets you display your panoramic images and videos on your websites within a few clicks. This Gutenberg block supports a variety of panoramic files such as .png, .jpeg, .mp4, and so on. The plugin is very easy to use, and anyone can configure the viewer without any technical knowledge.

Live Demos

  • Image Panorama Demo (Free Version)
  • Video Panorama Demo (Free Version)
  • Advanced Panorama Demos (Pro Version)

Get Pro (Panorama Viewer)

Looking for advanced features like interactive Virtual Tours with multi-scene support, markers, custom hotspots, Google Street View, and WooCommerce integration? The premium version Panorama Viewer Pro includes all features of the free Panorama Block plugin, plus these powerful tools to create immersive experiences.
* Upgrade to Panorama Viewer Pro

Key Features

  • Spherical 360° View: Spherical texture projections powered by WebGL/Three.js.
  • Image & Video Support: Supports panoramic images (PNG, JPEG) and video formats (MP4, WebM).
  • Auto-Rotation: Keeps visitors engaged by panning views automatically.
  • Speed Control: Set custom rotation speed dynamically inside the editor.
  • Toggle Viewer Controls: Show or hide user controls for manual panning, zooming, and dragging.
  • Autoplay, Mute, & Loop: Custom playback settings for 360-degree video block configurations.
  • Uninstall Data Clean-up: Safe option to delete settings from the database upon deletion.

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Panorama Block
  3. Click on the Panorama Block to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Panorama Block plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the panorama-block.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Panorama Block plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is Panorama Block free?

Yes, Panorama Block is a free Gutenberg Block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here

Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the Panorama Block plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.
